description: Department of Archaeology - The Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188) Notification Under Section 33, Area reserved for Archaeological Purposes of Rasnaka Wewa
reasoning: This gazette notification declares a specific area of state land as an "Archaeological reserve" under the Antiquities Ordinance. The content focuses exclusively on land matters, specifically the reservation and definition of a parcel of land for archaeological purposes, including its location, extent, and lot numbers. It does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
